# kion_billing_source_oci (Resource)

Manages a Kion OCI Billing Source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_billing_source_oci" "example" {
  # Required
  billing_start_date = "2026-01"

  # Optional
  # account_type_id         = 1
  # fingerprint             = "example"
  # is_parent_tenancy       = false
  # name                    = "example"
  # private_key             = "example"
  # region                  = "example"
  # skip_validation         = false
  # tenancy_ocid            = "example"
  # use_focus_reports       = false
  # use_proprietary_reports = false
  # user_ocid               = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_start_date` (String) Start date of billing source (YYYY-MM).

### Optional

- `account_type_id` (Number) The Account Type ID is the corresponding billing source account's type.
26 - OCI Commercial
27 - OCI Government
28 - OCI Federal
- `fingerprint` (String) The api access fingerprint
- `is_parent_tenancy` (Boolean) Indicates whether the billing source is a parent OCI tenancy.
- `name` (String) Name of the billing source.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The private key used for API Access
- `region` (String) The OCI default api region
- `skip_validation` (Boolean) When true, will skip validating the connection to the billing source
- `tenancy_ocid` (String) The OCID of the tenancy
- `use_focus_reports` (Boolean) Use FOCUS Reports - If true, Kion will use FOCUS reports for this billing source
- `use_proprietary_reports` (Boolean) Use Proprietary Reports - If true, Kion will use proprietary reports for this billing source
- `user_ocid` (String) The OCID of the api user

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the OCI billing source.
